description:
A desktop mod manager for games supported by ModWorkshop.

Modrex is a free, open-source desktop mod manager for PAYDAY 3, PAYDAY 2,
PAYDAY: The Heist, and Crime Boss: Rockay City. Browse, install, organize,
update, enable, and disable mods from ModWorkshop, then launch each game
modded or vanilla directly from the app.
Added
- Added Cyberpunk 2077 support for Steam and the Epic Games Store. (#199 by @TarekLP)
- Added a setting to make the interface's corners sharper or rounder. (#199 by @TarekLP)
- Added pink as an accent color. (#199 by @TarekLP)
- Added a Nightly update channel for testing new features early. (#214)
- Added short animations to dialogs, menus, tooltips and buttons. (#224)
- Added mod profiles for each game. (#226)
- Added sharing and importing profiles. (#226)
Changed
- The purple accent color is now deeper. (#199 by @TarekLP)
- Usage analytics now include your language. (#212)
- Folder names being edited no longer show a focus outline. (#226)
- Launching without mods now uses the game's .modrex folder. (#226)
Fixed
- Fixed PAYDAY 3 and Crime Boss mods set aside for a launch without mods being deleted when their folder was recreated while the game ran. (#199 by @TarekLP)
- Fixed a failed update install leaving Modrex with no window. (#214)
- Fixed interface errors missing from the log. (#214)
- Fixed the mods folder being recreated during a launch without mods. (#214)
- Fixed update checks and downloads hanging on a stalled connection. (#214)
- Fixed update checks wrongly saying you're up to date. (#214)
- Fixed the page selector flickering on Nexus Mods. (#222)
- Fixed disabled hand-installed Diesel mods reappearing as new mods. (#226)
- Fixed ModWorkshop installs removing Nexus mods with the same id. (#226)
- Fixed bursts of requests running into ModWorkshop's rate limit. (#226)
- Fixed reinstalls moving a mod's files into one folder. (#226)
Contributors
Thank you to everyone who contributed to this release: @illianezheviasov, @ShulhaOleh, @TarekLP
